done_when: When today's review loop stop fires (third blocked review in a file flagged before), close and forge land stay stopped on that item until the human's choice is recorded with one command the stop message names: narrow the part, split it, or accept the remaining findings; forge next shows the three choices in plain words; skill.md tells the coordinator to ask the human and never re-run close past it; new client repos get it from init and existing ones from sync on upgrade, with a command test for each
why: The review loop stop pauses only one close, so a coordinator's next close carries on and a part can loop through 8 blocked reviews
